verdict.rationale: A probe found an official BVNK CLI repository (bvnk/agent-wallet-cli), so an official CLI exists and is apparently aimed at agent workflows. Its name suggests it may cover only agent wallets rather than the full BVNK API, and the pack has no detail on its commands, auth handling or install. Missing for 10: documented CLI command coverage across BVNK's API surface (payments, payouts, virtual accounts), install/auth instructions in first-party docs, any hands-on or independent corroboration of the CLI working.
